label: Which rule format fits a CVE
description: How the CVE page recommends a rule format: by weakness (CWE id) and by words of the affected product / description. Each match adds its weight to the formats it lists; the best ones are shown with the reason. A Nuclei template found for the CVE also adds Suricata and Sigma (the exploit request is known).

CWE-79.why: Web injection (XSS): the exploit travels in HTTP requests

CWE-89.why: SQL injection: visible in HTTP requests and web server logs

CWE-22.why: Path traversal: ../ sequences in requests and logs

CWE-77.why: Command injection: in requests, then process creation on the host

CWE-78.why: OS command injection: in requests, then process creation on the host

CWE-94.why: Code injection: in requests; dropped payloads can be matched by YARA

CWE-502.why: Deserialization: serialized gadget payloads on the wire or in files

CWE-434.why: Unrestricted upload: the upload request, then the webshell file

CWE-287.why: Authentication bypass: the crafted request and the access logs

CWE-306.why: Missing authentication: requests to the exposed endpoint

CWE-288.why: Authentication bypass by alternate path: the crafted request

CWE-611.why: XXE: the XML entity payload in requests

CWE-787.why: Memory corruption: exploit files or malware carrying the exploit

CWE-119.why: Memory corruption: exploit files or malware carrying the exploit

CWE-120.why: Buffer overflow: exploit files or malware carrying the exploit

CWE-122.why: Heap overflow: exploit files or malware carrying the exploit

CWE-416.why: Use after free: exploit documents / binaries

CWE-269.why: Privilege escalation: process and event logs on the host

CWE-250.why: Excessive privileges: process and event logs on the host

CWE-427.why: DLL search-order hijack: image loads, the planted DLL

CWE-426.why: Untrusted search path: image loads, the planted binary

kernel.why: Local exploit: host logs, exploit binary

vpn.why: Edge device: network traffic and its logs

firewall.why: Edge device: network traffic and its logs

gateway.why: Edge device: network traffic and its logs

nuclei_bonus.why: A Nuclei template shows the exact exploit request
